resources.string: None waiting. gig.log keeps up to 3 a day from your shifts.
Waiting for the daily census upload

Each row is what gig.log sends about one text on this screen: a one-way code, a format or a kind. A word you confirm as the app\'s own wording is sent as text, and only after other drivers confirm it too. Covered rows stay covered.
You can review after your shift ends.
Come back tomorrow. The census server checks a screen\'s words the day after it receives the screen.
This review is gone: it was sent, deleted or more than 7 days old.
Reviewing is off, so gig.log shows and sends no review.
Sent. A confirmed word went as its one-way code. gig.log sends the word itself only after other drivers confirm it.
Deleted. gig.log sent no review of this screen.
gig.log restarted since it saw this screen, so its words are no longer on this phone. You can still label fields.
The census server hasn\'t prepared today\'s word check yet. Try again in an hour; you can still label fields.
gig.log couldn\'t reach the census server, so no word can be checked.
The census server is paused or this phone\'s reviews for today are used up. The review waits; try again later.
gig.log couldn\'t reach the census server. The review waits; try again later.
Not seen by enough drivers yet

Sends the developer this screen\'s outline as the rows show it, with your confirmations and labels. Covered rows stay covered. A confirmed word goes as its one-way code unless other drivers have confirmed it too. Only the developer can open it, and the census server deletes it after 3 days.
Not sure what this screen is
Sent to the developer. The census server deletes it by %1$s.
Sent to the developer, but gig.log couldn\'t confirm that the server kept the same outline this screen showed. The census server deletes it by %1$s.
The census server is paused or today\'s questions for the developer are used up. Nothing was sent; try again later.
gig.log couldn\'t reach the census server. Nothing was sent; try again later.
The census server couldn\'t take this screen, so nothing was sent to the developer.
The census server can\'t take questions for the developer yet, so nothing was sent.
